name: Jump Boy LIVE
overview: Kim l-on is a bottom-tier student at a science high school who dreams of becoming an influencer but struggles with single-digit viewers on his meteor shower livestreams. Everything changes when he grabs a fallen meteorite and starts teleporting across the globe! As his teleportation is broadcast live to the world, l-on becomes an overnight sensation. But before he can even uncover the secret of the meteorite, he's pursued by those who want it for themselves. Tesla (Tae-sul) joins him to protect both l-on and the meteorite, just as they discover an even greater crisis looming on the horizon.
